name: dropshipping-hub
description: Hub de Automação de Dropshipping Cross-Border - AliExpress ↔ Mercado Livre + Shopee

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && cd ../frontend && npm install
